value.rationale: This is a natural optimization geometry for the newly proved maximal-volume nine-vertex spherical configuration: both extremal ellipsoids are computed for an entire combinatorial family rather than an arbitrary discrete example. The sharp six-versus-nine outer contact transition, exact minimal outer/inner volume distortion, and provably distinct optimal inradius, ordinary volume and ellipsoid distortion are structural, geometrically motivated results with uses in shape comparison and approximation. Their values are not already consequences of the source ordinary-volume theorem.
